title: Tabdoc Object Model
description: Defines the entity contracts for the Tabdoc TinApp. These schemas describe the data shapes exchanged between the UI layer, agent tools, and the backend runtime.

document.description: An organization-scoped document (+ owner). Documents form a tree via parent_id and carry versioned content through revisions. space_id is legacy optional context only.

space_id.description: Legacy optional context; not required for org-owned documents.

parent_id.description: Parent document UUID for tree hierarchy. Null for root documents.

updated_by.description: User ID of the last editor

revision.description: An immutable content snapshot of a document at a given version number. Supports ProseMirror JSON, Markdown, and plaintext representations.

content_pm_json.description: ProseMirror document JSON (used by the Tiptap editor)

content_plaintext.description: Plain text representation for search indexing

editor.description: User ID of the revision author

permission.description: Access control entry binding a subject (user or role) to a document with a permission level.

created_by.description: User ID who granted this permission
